post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: The first combined historical-final template inventory returned no visible projection, leaving file size and interface discovery unattributable.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: All three historical templates were then measured and the required builder, test, and validator interfaces were read without repository mutation.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Probe the three exact template paths and inspect only the bounded interface sections needed for owner adaptation.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Separate scalar file existence and size probes from broad content searches when reading historical sparse worktrees.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A large closeout-template patch returned a truncated tool display, so its application state was not attributable from the wrapper response alone.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The bounded inspection proved that the drawing-domain replacements landed and identified every remaining stale template constant without repository-side guessing.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Inspect the exact target file with bounded literal searches before issuing any follow-on edit.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Split large semantic patches into bounded edits and verify exact target strings whenever the tool display is truncated.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: A combined immutable-manifest projection displayed the x1 result but omitted the evidence result, leaving the second manifest count unattributed.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The scalar recovery verified 172 evidence entries, two declared self-exclusions, and the normalized exact-Git-blob hash domain.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Read the exact evidence-manifest Git blob into one scalar object and project only its count, exclusions, and hash domain.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Use one literal manifest and one scalar projection per immutable lifecycle probe.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: The first compound final-stage wrapper returned no attributable completion display; an immediate audit found only the staged review, while both manifests appeared and were staged later by the delayed wrapper.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The first audit recorded 23 staged paths and absent manifests; the later reconciliation attributed the delayed 24-path state and prevented stale manifests from receiving final credit.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Reconcile the exact index twice, wait for command quiescence, unstage the owner closeout surface, refresh counts, and rerun each lifecycle command separately.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Run staging, staged review, and each manifest lifecycle as separate bounded commands with scalar receipts.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: The first exact unstage command included an untracked staged-review path; Git rejected that pathspec and left all 24 indexed paths unchanged.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The corrected command left zero cached paths and preserved all 25 owner files in the worktree.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Remove the untracked path from the index-only pathspec and unstage only paths confirmed by the cached-diff inventory.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Build index-only restore pathspecs from cached-diff membership; handle untracked files separately.

post_evidence_rows.failed_witness: The isolated final-manifest generator exceeded the foreground yield and its tool cell closed without returning the requested scalar receipt.
post_evidence_rows.passing_bounded_witness: The recovery attributed 22 delta entries, 195 owner entries, three self-exclusions per manifest, and an unchanged 23-path pre-manifest index.
post_evidence_rows.recovery: Inspect both literal manifest files and the exact cached index in a separate bounded call before assigning any manifest credit.
post_evidence_rows.recurrence_guard: Start long manifest generation with a short session yield, then poll its explicit execution session before inspecting outputs.
